Design of automatic irrigation system for greenhouse based on LoRa technology

Van Anh Vu, Dong Cong Trinh, Tuan Christian TRUVANT, Thanh Dang Bui

2018 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Communications (ATC) · pp. 72–77

Publisher / DOIRead PDF

Overview

A LoRa-based wireless sensing and control network for greenhouse irrigation, integrating environmental data acquisition, remote monitoring, and automated irrigation control. The design connects distributed sensing with coordinated device communication for agricultural automation.
